adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `deleteEvent` now computes `calendarId` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is not supplied (the else-branch), the `.find` predicate compares each `cal.externalId` to the falsy `externalCalendarId` (likely `undefined`/`null`), so it will typically return `undefined`, making `calendarId` undefined rather than falling back to a destination calendar externalId. This is a regression from the previous logic (`... : event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and can cause deletes to target no calendar (or force fallback behavior elsewhere), leading to failed deletions/orphaned events as described.
